parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. Looking at my resources, I have 1 Ore, 2 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. My production at Node 42 gives me Ore on 5 (which just rolled, giving me this Ore) and Wheat on 9. Node 14 gives me Wheat on 8. While Ore is valuable for cities and development cards, I am currently desperate for Brick to build roads toward Node 31 or 40. However, Gemma is my current ally against Claude. Accepting this trade gives me a total of 3 Wheat. Since I already have 2 Wood and 1 Sheep, I'm getting closer to a settlement (need Brick) or a City (need more Ore). More importantly, keeping Gemma friendly and Claude isolated is key. 2-for-1 is a generous offer from her. I will accept to maintain the alliance and consolidate resources, even though I lose my only Ore for now.
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted Gemma's 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. Current resources: 3 Wheat, 2 Wood, 1 Sheep. Still need Brick for a road/settlement. Alliance with Gemma is stable.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'מה, הצעה הוגנת מאוד. אני אקח את זה, במילא האבן הזאת סתם שוכבת אצלי כרגע ועדיף שהיא תלך למישהי שבאמת מנסה לעצור את קלוד.
